Note:
[General game notes]
Cruncheevos script: https://github.com/akleemans/retroachievements-scripts

[8-bit] Player controller input
Bit0 = A
Bit1 = B
Bit2 = Select
Bit3 = Start
Bit4 = Right
Bit5 = Left
Bit6 = Up
Bit7 = Down
[8-bit] Background scroll X (screen X shadow, all levels)
[Lower4] Score x0000
[Lower4] Score 0x000
[Lower4] Score 00x00
[Lower4] Score 000x0
[Lower4] Score 0000x
[16-bit] Score
[16-bit] High score
[8-bit] Level 1: scroll column, 0 at level start
[8-bit] Level 1: Number of correct power generators shot
[8-bit] Loop frame counter (+1 per frame, wraps at 0x95), frozen while paused and on text screens
[8-bit] Level (1-6)
[8-bit] Level 2: final room reached (doors only work once this is 1)
[8-bit] Level 2: door the player is standing at (0 = none, 1-5, door 4 is always correct)
[8-bit] Level 2: mysterious person spawned (0 -> 1)
[8-bit] Level 2: timer (x of the timer arrow), starts at 0x04, stops at 0xa3; runs from the level start, only visible after the hint is picked up

[8-bit] Level end / event code (0 during play, set once, stays until the text screen ends)
0x01 = After a game over screen
0x02 = L1 generators wrong order (game over)
0x03 = Died in levels 1-3
0x06 = L1 complete
0x07 = L2 complete
0x08 = L3 complete
0x09 = L3 timeout, retry
0x0a = L3 timeout, game over
0x0b = Died in levels 4-6
0x0c = L4 complete
0x0e = L5 complete
0x0f = L6 complete
0x10 = L3 circuit done
[16-bit] Text pointer

[8-bit] Level 3 node #1
0x01 = Display 1
0x00 = Display 0

[8-bit] Level 3 node #2
0x01 = Display 1
0x00 = Display 0

[8-bit] Level 3 node #3
0x01 = Display 1
0x00 = Display 0

[8-bit] Level 3 node #4
0x01 = Display 1
0x00 = Display 0
[8-bit] Level 3 timer x:00 (minutes)
[8-bit] Level 3 timer 0:x0
[8-bit] Level 3 timer 0:0x
[8-bit] Level 3: chances left (2 on new game, -1 per timeout)

[8-bit] Level 1: hint item column
0x6c = Not picked up
0x00 = Picked up

[8-bit] Level 5: item picked up flag
0x00 = No item picked up yet
0xff = Any keycard/arm picked up (reset at level start)
[8-bit] Level 1: Number of total power generators shot
[8-bit] Level 4: scroll X of the lower screen split (truck layer)

[8-bit] Level 4: truck state
0x00 = Approaching
0x01, 0x02, 0x05 = Attack phases
0x03 = Destroyed (exploding)
0x04 = End animation done
[8-bit] Level 4: truck health (starts at 5, 0xff = destroyed)
[8-bit] Level 4: hits left until the next truck health step (0x14 per step)
[8-bit] Weapon; Level 5: 0x00 = Rifle, 0x01 = Shotgun; Level 6: 0x00 = Fists only
[8-bit] Levels 5-6: ammo bar (0x00-0xe0, full = 0xe0) - refilled to 0xe0 when switching from rifle to shotgun (see 0xd12e)
[8-bit] Level 6: T-1000 true form (0 -> 1 when its HP runs out)
[8-bit] Level 2: hint picked up (0 -> 1)
[8-bit] Level 3: circuits completed (0-3)

[8-bit] Object table start (17 slots x 0x1a bytes, slot 0 = player) / Player object type
0x0a = Levels 1-2
0x2a = Level 4
0x22 = Level 5
0x3c = Level 6
0x09 = Dying

[8-bit] Player state
0x85 = Punching
0x86 = Entering a door (level 2) / being hit (level 6)
[8-bit] Health (Full health: 0xe0)
[8-bit] Player timer. Level 2: door entry countdown (starts at 0x3c, door opens at 0); Level 6: punch animation frame (punch deals damage at 0x03)
[8-bit] Player y-coordinate (all levels)
[8-bit] Player x-coordinate (all levels). On foot the screen scrolls, so it mostly stays around 0x50

[8-bit] Object slot 5 type (boss slot)
0x02 = L1 generator
0x07 = L1 HK tank
0x12 = L1 HK tank destroyed
0x31 = L5 barrier/turret
0x3d = L6 T-1000

[8-bit] Object slot 5 state (used in Level 6)
0x07 = T-1000 true form
0x08 = Falling into the melt pool
[8-bit] Object slot 5 HP (boss slot). Level 1: generator (10) / HK tank (0x28); Level 5: barrier/turret (0x14); Level 6: T-1000 (0xdc)
[8-bit] Object slot 6 type; Level 5: 0x32 = Keycard/arm on screen
[8-bit] Object slot 6: level 5 item list index (0-3)
[8-bit] Object slot 6: level 5 item is the arm (0 = keycard, 1 = arm)
[8-bit] Object slot 7 HP (slot assigned on spawn; level 5: usually the 1st ceiling turret)
[8-bit] Object slot 8 HP (slot assigned on spawn; level 5: usually the turret before the barrier)
[8-bit] Object slot 9 HP (slot assigned on spawn; level 5: usually the 2nd ceiling turret)
[8-bit] Object slot 10 HP (slot assigned on spawn; level 5: usually the 3rd ceiling turret)
[8-bit] Object slot 11 HP (slot assigned on spawn)
[8-bit] Level 1 generator list (5 x 4 bytes: column, height, order, 0); column = 0x00 once destroyed

[8-bit] Level 1 mine #1
0x04 = Present
0x00 = Gone

[8-bit] Level 1 mine #2
0x24 = Present
0x00 = Gone

[8-bit] Level 1 mine #3
0x28 = Present
0x00 = Gone

[8-bit] Level 1 mine #4
0x4b = Present
0x00 = Gone

[8-bit] Level 1 mine #5
0x5a = Present
0x00 = Gone

[8-bit] Level 1 mine #6
0x5f = Present
0x00 = Gone

[8-bit] Level 1 mine #7
0x64 = Present
0x00 = Gone

[8-bit] Level 1 mine #8
0x82 = Present
0x00 = Gone

[8-bit] Level 1 mine #9
0x94 = Present
0x00 = Gone
[8-bit] Level 5 item list: keycard #1 column (4 x 4 bytes); 0x00 = On screen or collected
[8-bit] Level 5 keycard #2 column (exit keycard), 0x00 = On screen or collected
[8-bit] Level 5 keycard #3 column; 0x00 = On screen or collected
[8-bit] Level 5 T-800 arm column; 0x00 = On screen or collected

[8-bit] Level 5 barrier #1 column (list of 4 x 4 bytes)
0x37 = Not spawned yet
0x00 = On screen or destroyed

[8-bit] Level 5 barrier #3 column
0x1a = Not spawned yet
0x00 = On screen or destroyed

[8-bit] Level 5 barrier #4 column
0x4f = Not spawned yet
0x00 = On screen, destroyed, or the arm was picked up
